verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded documents multi-state payroll. It handles companies with work locations across different states, lists 'Handle multi-state tax requirements' as a capability, and covers federal, state and local filings and payments, with employee state tax setup and automatic tax calculation supporting per-state withholding. However, nothing in the evidence documents state tax registration (obtaining or managing per-state employer registrations or account numbers), and all support comes from vendor overview-level claims. Missing for 10: documented per-state employer tax registration handling, detailed per-state withholding configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-state payroll accuracy.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run payroll for employees across multiple states with the right registrations and withholdings per state
